title: Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies
abstract: arXiv:2609.13201v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training datasets for upcoming LLMs would include a significant amount of AI text/image data generated from current LLMs. In such a scenario, it is important to understand how this affects batch decompositions and thereby, the performance of the resultant new LLM. In this paper, we consider AI generated data as anomalies ``linked" to main data points and study decomposition and undersampling properties of the overall random dataset. We use redundancy graphs and iteration techniques to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a strongly dissimilar (SD) decomposition and demonstrate a phase transition phenomena, wherein the minimum size is essentially determined by the \emph{main} data points when the number of anomalies is small and is ``taken" over by the anomalies above a certain threshold. We also establish a size criticality result for the strong similarity of a randomly undersampled dataset and illustrate our results with examples invol

translated_title: 含异常随机数据集的相异分解与欠采样中的临界性
translated_abstract: 未来大型语言模型（LLM）的训练数据集将包含大量由当前LLM生成的AI文本/图像数据。在这种情况下，理解这如何影响批次分解以及进而影响新LLM的性能十分重要。本文将AI生成的数据视为与主数据点“关联”的异常，并研究整个随机数据集的分解与欠采样特性。我们利用冗余图和迭代技术得到了强相异（SD）分解最小规模的界，并展示了一种相变现象：当异常数量较小时，最小规模基本由“主”数据点决定，而当异常数量超过某个阈值后，最小规模则被异常“接管”。此外，我们还建立了随机欠采样数据集强相似性的规模临界性结果，并通过具体实例对研究结果进行了说明。
tldr: 本文研究了将AI生成数据视为异常的随机数据集的强相异分解与欠采样问题，发现存在相变现象：异常数量较少时分解最小规模由主数据点决定，超过阈值后则被异常主导。
en_tdlr: This paper studies strongly dissimilar decomposition and undersampling of random datasets with AI-generated data as anomalies, revealing a phase transition where the minimum decomposition size is determined by main data points when anomalies are few, but is taken over by anomalies beyond a certain threshold.
